response: Saved Views is available today and included in all paid plans. Instead of rebuilding your filters, sorting, and grouping every time you open a project, you can now save the exact configuration you rely on and return to it in one click. Each user can save up to 50 views, so whether you track priority bugs, this week's tasks, or a specific teammate's workload, your setup is always ready when you need it. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to give everyone the same lens on a project without repeating instructions or screenshots. Shared views update automatically as underlying data changes, so the whole team stays aligned on what matters most right now. Setting one up takes seconds, and there is no separate configuration screen to learn. This feature is rolling out across every workspace starting now, with no additional setup required beyond your first save. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
